mcp_tools.name: production_rust_engineering_pack_expert
mcp_tools.title: Production rust engineering pack expert
mcp_tools.description: Submits an expert-level production Rust engineering record (lifetime architecture, type-system and API design, async runtime depth, performance measurement and allocation discipline, unsafe/FFI/wasm practice with declared FFI binding rows, cryptography and secret handling, expert red lines) and returns a deterministic PRODUCTION_RUST_ENGINEERING_PACK_EXPERT_READY / PRODUCTION_RUST_ENGINEERING_PACK_EXPERT_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed per-binding safe-wrapper, SAFETY-comment and miri-test coverage checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared engineering record only; it inspects no real code and prescribes no design.

inputSchema.description: The production rust engineering pack expert manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All 37 checks pass. Computed spot checks: ffi_bindings_count=1, safe_wrapper_coverage=1.000000
